name: Netevia
tagline: Mobile business banking — accounts, cards, transfers and rewards for US business owners
role: Mobile development for a US business-banking fintech

scenes.title: Banking on iOS and Android
scenes.body: One React Native codebase for accounts, cards, transfers and rewards, in English and Spanish.

scenes.title: Every account on one home screen
scenes.body: Netevia and Plaid-linked external accounts in one place, plus cash-flow and balance-history charts.

scenes.title: Transfers and activity search
scenes.body: ACH, own-account and customer transfers, automations, CSV or PDF statements, and activity filtered by date, category or card.

scenes.title: Virtual cards with spend controls
scenes.body: Virtual, burner and physical cards with limits by country and merchant category, plus Apple Wallet.

scenes.title: Rewards with a full points ledger
scenes.body: Points charted by 6M, 1Y, QTD or YTD, an earned and redeemed history, and PDF statements.

scenes.title: Gift cards paid for with points
scenes.body: A searchable brand catalog with filters, in-app ordering and a My Gift Cards wallet.

scenes.title: Onboarding and secure sign-in
scenes.body: Multi-step sign-up with document upload, then MFA and optional biometric login.
